#Copilot instructions 
Write automated  tests in Playwright following these guidelines : 

- Follow Playwright best practices
- Do not add comments in each line of code
- Write only the Playwwright test steps for the Scenario
- Use descriptive test names
- Read and analyse the proided DOM context from the browser
- Use the provided context to write tests
- Create one test at a time unless specified otherwise
- Prioritize `getByRole()` and `getByText()` selectors over `locator()` when possible
- Use `beforeEach` hooks for common setup tasks
- Keep Test code clean and focused on the scenario
- Don't add assestions until asked to do so
- For the ranbodm test data, keep it short and compact. Don't write long texts.
